leadText:
Muneo Saitō (Japanese: 斉藤 むねお; born: February 15, 1966) is the of the series Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys.

He has also worked for Game Freak as a Pokémon designer since Generation II, with , , and as the notable ones. During his playthrough of , he chose as his first partner Pokémon.
